identity.note: This identifies the published Nologo reference, not every board marketed as SuperMini.

review_scope: Manufacturer-source electrical and mechanical review; no physical sample measurements, RF test, assembly trial or production release.

mechanical.view: Top view, USB at positive Y, ceramic antenna at negative Y
mechanical.source_outline_note: Native PCB outline is about 17.932 x 22.521 mm; manufacturer dimension illustration states 18.00 x 22.50 mm. Use nominal body as a placement envelope and inspect the actual module before manufacture.
mechanical.native_source_limit: Published PcbDoc has only two header components and sixteen inner through-hole pads; no complete module circuitry, outer castellations or 3D bodies. It is not complete production module CAD. Repository Hardware directory currently supplies this PcbDoc and two PNGs, not KiCad files.

underside.smd_components: Manufacturer states single-sided assembly; official bottom view shows none.
underside.usb_shield_features: USB shield mounting solder/pin features occupy underside near USB. Exact protrusion is not dimensioned.
underside.carrier_constraint: No components under the module. Keep exposed unrelated copper clear of underside metal. Provide USB-tail cavity or measured standoff clearance.

antenna.engineering_policy: Place antenna end over carrier edge / open cutout. Keep carrier copper, components, screws and conductive enclosure features away. Do not present an invented numerical keepout as a Nologo requirement.

z.note: Old R3 3.1 mm standoff and 7.2 mm total body were illustration choices. They are not valid evidence for direct SMD assembly or final case tolerances.

pins.name: 5V
pins.carrier_function: Switched isolated supply; shared internally with USB VBUS

pins.name: 3V3
pins.carrier_function: Supply OUT to ISO1042 logic; no second regulator here

carrier_land_proposal.mode: optional multimode prototype carrier, manual soldering preferred
carrier_land_proposal.pin_number_policy: Inner PTH and outer SMD primitives of each contact use the same pin number and net.
carrier_land_proposal.paste_policy: Do not assume automatic reflow is qualified. Open carrier PTH barrels can wick solder away from flat SMT module joints. Use dedicated SMD-only variant or an assembler-approved filled-hole/paste process for factory SMT.
qualification_needed: Identify actual purchased Nologo module revision
Verify outer contact dimensions, USB lower protrusion and plating
Check physical placement and accessible fillet
Approve stencil/assembly process if factory mounting requested

verified_module_network: USB VBUS pins and module 5V header pin are the SAME VBUS net
VSYS -> ME6211 3.3V SOT23-5 LDO IN and EN
LDO OUT -> module 3V3 header and ESP supply
power.range_note: Manufacturer marketing input range does not guarantee regulated 3.3V at the lowest input and maximum load; diode and LDO dropout remain.
power.external_3v3_reason: Parallels the onboard LDO when USB is active; ME6211 absolute VOUT limit is VIN+0.3V, so driving its output with unpowered VIN is not qualified.
power.recommended_topology: Isolated secondary supply -> accessible RUN/SERVICE switch -> module 5V pin. SERVICE opens this positive supply before connecting USB. Module 3V3 output supplies only ISO1042 VCC1 and local decoupling. GND_LOGIC remains common, isolated from GND_BUS.

switch.RUN: External isolated supply connected, do not connect USB cable
switch.SERVICE: External isolated supply disconnected, USB may supply the original module and logic

module_ldo.thermal_example: At 0.25 A, 5.0V header and assumed 0.3V BAT60J drop: LDO dissipates (4.7-3.3)*0.25=0.35W; published thetaJA gives 73.5 C rise. This is a rough package-board estimate, not measured Nologo thermal performance.

isolated_source_constraints: Do not treat unregulated B0505S output as exact 5.0V.
Keep its preload and verify maximum/minimum loaded output and startup against module input limits.
If needed, retain/add a secondary limiter or regulator before the module 5V input; never connect a separate 3.3V source to the module output.
Check startup, radio bursts, continuous operation and case temperature on the assembled original module.
carrier_circuits_to_remove_when_using_mo: Separate carrier USB connector and its USB-data/CC network unless separately justified
Carrier 3.3V regulator connected to MCU supply
Duplicate ESP EN/BOOT/reset circuit already present on module
carrier_circuits_to_keep: ISO1042 VCC1 bypass close to IC
3.2mm BUS/LOGIC copper separation inherited as carrier engineering rule

supply_envelope_review.decision: Direct unregulated connection is plausible within a restricted steady-state calculation but is NOT proven safe over all R5 operating conditions. Retain a properly reviewed secondary regulated supply for a defensible production design; set its voltage only after module/dropout and power-budget checks.

evisun_published_bounds.notes: Envelope chart visually inspected from actual manufacturer PDF; its 10% lower bound is 0%, not -2.5%. Temperature coefficient is only typical and specified at full load. Do not stack 12% typical load regulation on top of the already load-dependent envelope.

stationary_calculations.meaning: published steady envelope at10% load; no startup claim

stationary_calculations.case: primary5.05V CCM maximum, line regulation stacked multiplicatively
same plus full120mVpp as conservative positive allowance
stationary_calculations.limitations: Uses published ripple maximum as a conservative positive excursion, without claiming its full operating-range applicability.
Typical full-load temperature coefficient extrapolated to light load is NOT a guaranteed maximum.

stationary_calculations.meaning: Shows that full converter input specification alone cannot guarantee a6V module input limit; upstream regulation matters.

supply_envelope_review.RUN: Module adds load, but direct input retains load-dependent raw voltage, converter startup/load-step uncertainty and greater onboard LDO heating.
supply_envelope_review.SERVICE: Physical open switch isolates module from raw rail, so raw secondary high voltage does not reach module. Raw-secondary preload stays connected. USB alone powers module. Before returning to RUN, USB must be unplugged; RUN reconnect transient still requires validation.
why_not_production_proof: AP63205 feedback4.95-5.05V bound is explicitly CCM; do not assume it independently certifies every light-load PFM transient
EVISUN temperature coefficient is typical only and at full load
EVISUN does not specify maximum startup or abrupt load-release overshoot
Source maximum600mA and3W constrain additional conversion loss
Real Nologo module revision, diode drop and onboard LDO thermal behavior still require confirmation

requirements: AP63203 is documented as fixed3.3V; do not just relabel it4.5V
AP63200 uses500kHz vs existingAP63203 1.1MHz; review inductor and compensation/feedforward per datasheet
Set feedback using Vout=0.8*(1+Rtop/Rbottom); include reference/divider tolerances
Near low raw output the buck enters dropout:4.5V regulation is not guaranteed without headroom
Check remaining internal BAT60J drop and ME6211 margin at peak load
No extra series OR diode is needed for the stated physically disconnected SERVICE topology; any retained diode consumes dropout budget
Worst-case input current plus preload must stay below600mA and3W
review_options.benefit: Defined lower upper voltage and lower onboard LDO dissipation than direct raw supply

requirements: Same datasheet pinout and1.1MHz as existingAP63203; existing4.7uH/2x22uF corresponds to manufacturer5V reference
Still review startup, low-input dropout, load transients and power budget
Do not promise5.0V when raw input is below output plus loss
review_options.benefit: Uses already sourced R4 part family/MPN option and limits high raw voltage; less LDO thermal improvement than4.5V

budget_example.note: This conservative80% example fails; do not transfer the R4 3.3V/500mA budget to an externally5V-fed SuperMini. Actual high-duty efficiency and load current must be qualified. A buck in dropout does not maintain its nominated output voltage.

supply_envelope_review.recommended_next_design_gate: Confirm actual SuperMini variant first; then explicitly select and review secondary regulator voltage, diode path, minimum voltage and thermal/current budget before changing CAD.

procurement.public_search_result: No exact Nologo ESP32-C3 SuperMini assembly part verified on 2026-09-23. This is not proof that procurement is impossible.

rejected_near_match.reason: Different MCU and board; not the requested original ESP32-C3 SuperMini.

delivery_options: JLC assembles carrier; exact original SuperMini added separately by user/assembler
Consign exact original module only after JLC accepts manufacturer, package, orientation and assembly process
procurement.jlc_requirements: Consigned/preordered parts must be received in inventory and selected during component matching before the assembled order proceeds. Do not invent a C-code or claim direct all-populated PCBA availability.

open_inputs_before_fabrication_release: Exact module supplier/revision or physical sample dimensions
Final choice between direct castellated mounting and header alternative
USB shield underside clearance and module/USB maximum Z envelope
Module assembly responsibility: manual or confirmed JLC consignment
Electrical supply load/thermal validation after complete R5 power design
